Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before editing.

Never commit the ROM or ROM-derived files (`zelda3.sfc`, `*.sfc`, `zelda3_assets.dat`, extracted `assets/` dumps, `tables/`). No exceptions. Run `bash scripts/check-no-copyrighted-assets.sh` before commit. Do not `git add -A` / `-f` / `--no-verify`. Open PRs against `jslay88/zelda3` (`--repo jslay88/zelda3`), not `snesrev/zelda3`.
